noticias.titulo: Strong Earnings Prove No Match for the Crumbling AI Trade
noticias.resumo: The strong earnings cycle was not enough to support the stock market as a Democratic sweep of US midterm elections raised the prospect of tighter regulation of data centers, threatening a central pillar of the artificial intelligence boom — not to mention the S&P 500's future profit growth.  The shock ouster of Nvidia Corp.  founder Jensen Huang also rattled nervous investors.

noticias.titulo: B3 to Add Brazilian Companies Listed Abroad to Ibovespa Index Next Year - Bloomberg
noticias.resumo:
# B3 to Add Brazil Stocks Listed Abroad to Aid Ailing Local Market

## Takeaways by Bloomberg AISubscribe

Brazil’s exchange operator B3 SA will incorporate shares of Brazilian companies listed abroad to the nation’s benchmark equity index starting next year in a push to boost liquidity after years of de-listings in the local market..

noticias.titulo: Has the AI Bubble Already Burst? - WSJ
noticias.resumo:
History may not repeat itself exactly, but the AI selloff ravaging the stock market in recent weeks is remarkably like the bursting of the dot-com bubble.  As investors continue to worry about whether there’s a bubble in AI, a valid question to ask is whether there was, and has it already popped. 

Consider some of the big technology names from the dot-com era that are still around.
